title: unify-terraform-private-state-layout-gpu-iam-networking-migration
author: Ava Chen
description: Summary: Unify Terraform state layout and introduce explicit modules for private deployment components (GPU node pools, IAM roles, and networking). This change factors previously ad-hoc resource definitions into reusable modules and provides a migration path (state move scripts + runbook) to the new organized layout so existing customer Private deployments can upgrade with minimal downtime. Motivation: We have been iterating on private deployment TF code across multiple repos and customer installs. During on-call and onboarding we hit brittle state layouts and duplicated IAM bindings. The new layout standardizes state namespaces, reduces drift risk, and enables future per-environment siloing (vpc/, iam/, gpu/). Checklist: - [x] Moduleized gpu-node-pool (GKE/Azure/eks supported) - [x] IAM module with least-privilege defaults and explicit mapping for service accounts - [x] Networking module to centralize subnet + routes + peering - [x] state-layout module + scripts to migrate existing tfstate objects - [x] acceptance tests and upgrade runbook - [x] CI pipelines adapted to validate plan against staging state Breaking changes / compatibility: This is backwards-compatible at the resource level but requires a one-time tf state mv for existing deployments. The migration script generates a dry-run plan and a recommended sequence of terraform state mv commands. Migration notes (high-level): 1) Run ./scripts/tfstate_migrate.sh --dry-run --env <env> to produce suggested state move commands. 2) Review diff and run with --apply in a maintenance window (expected <15m for typical customer states). 3) If using remote backend with locks, ensure operator holds the lock during state moves. 4) Post-migration: run terraform plan/apply to ensure drift is zero. Files changed (high-level): - modules/gpu-node-pool/{main.tf,variables.tf,outputs.tf,README.md} - modules/iam/{main.tf,policy_bindings.tf,variables.tf,README.md} - modules/networking/{main.tf,subnets.tf,outputs.tf,README.md} - modules/state-layout/README.md + scripts/tfstate_migrate.sh - examples/private-deploy/* (updated to reference modules) - .github/workflows/terraform.yml (added migration job and acceptance matrix) Tests & CI: Added acceptance tests that run a plan against a small test backend (GH actions job: terraform-acceptance). Initial CI run had a transient provider plugin timeout causing a rerun; after bumping provider plugin and adding retries the workflow stabilized. Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main and tag a 0.6.0 release for redwood-terraform. 2) Notify on-call and customers with private deployments one week in advance. 3) Run migration on staging customers and validate. 4) Schedule maintenance windows for production migrations. Related: ENG-1428 (tf unification), ENG-1439 (gpu autoscaling improvements), SUP-8742 (customer asked for clearer upgrade steps).

release_notes: v0.6.0: Unify Terraform state layout for Private deployments; introduce gpu-node-pool, iam, and networking modules; include migration scripts and runbook. Operators must run the provided state migration script during upgrade. See modules/state-layout/README.md for details.
